design.historicalAvailabilityAssumption: Kalshi completed candle plus five minutes; actual historical delivery latency is unobserved
design.executionAssumption: Coinbase daily first and last trade prices; venue fills, spread and Base gas are not observed; cost is an assumption

scores.grossSelectionRule: daily round trip when fitted positive-return probability exceeds 0.5; otherwise cash
scores.scope: exploratory single signal and asset; independent weekly-block approximation, no causal or cross-asset claim

value.grossSelectionRule: daily round trip when fitted positive-return probability exceeds 0.5; otherwise cash
value.scope: exploratory single signal and asset; independent weekly-block approximation, no causal or cross-asset claim
